s0301.literal: In the twelfth month, on guisi day, Pacify South General, Inspector of Xiangzhou, and Prince Shuling of Shixing was advanced to Garrison South General.
s0301.idiomatic: On guisi day in the twelfth month, Shuling, Prince of Shixing, pacify south general and inspector of Xiangzhou, was promoted to garrison south general.

s0302.literal: On wuxu day Minister of Personnel Wang Chang was made Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing; Minister of Revenue Kong Huan was made Minister of Personnel.
s0302.idiomatic: On wuxu day Wang Chang, minister of personnel, was made right ministerial aide; Kong Huan, minister of revenue, was made minister of personnel.

s0303.literal: On jingwu day Secure Right General and Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Tong was given special advancement.
s0303.idiomatic: On jingwu day Wang Tong, secure right general and left grand master of the palace, was given special advancement.

s0304.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on xinwei day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburbs.
s0304.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 7, on xinwei day, the emperor sacrificed at the southern suburbs in person.

s0305.literal: On yihai day Left Guard General Fan Yi captured Tongzhou city.
s0305.idiomatic: On yihai day Fan Yi, left guard general, took Tongzhou city.

s0306.literal: On xinsi day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the northern suburbs.
s0306.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor sacrificed at the northern suburbs in person.

s0307.literal: In the second month, on wushen day, Fan Yi captured Xiapi, Gaozhan, and six other cities.
s0307.idiomatic: In the second month, on wushen day, Fan Yi took Xiapi, Gaozhan, and six other cities.

s0308.literal: In the third month, on xinwei day, an edict ordered that in the nine provinces Yu, the two Yan, Qiao, Xu, He, Huo, South Sizhou, and Ding, and in the northern commanderies of the circuits of South Yu, Jiang, and Ying, Cloud-Banner righteous soldiers be established to join the great army and all garrisons in defense.
s0308.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei day, an edict ordered cloud-banner righteous soldiers set up in Yu, the two Yan, Qiao, Xu, He, Huo, South Sizhou, and Ding, and in the northern commanderies of South Yu, Jiang, and Ying, to join the great army and garrisons in defense.

s0309.literal: On wuyin day the newly appointed Campaign West Grand General, Inspector of Hezhou, and Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes Huang Faqu was made Inspector of Yuzhou.
s0309.idiomatic: On wuyin day Huang Faqu, newly appointed campaign west grand general, inspector of Hezhou, and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, was made inspector of Yuzhou.

s0310.literal: Liang's East Xuzhou was changed to Anzhou, and Wuzhou to Yuanzhou.
s0310.idiomatic: Liang's East Xuzhou was renamed Anzhou, and Wuzhou Yuanzhou.

s0311.literal: Qiaozhou's seat was moved to Xinchang commandery, and Qin commandery was placed under it.
s0311.idiomatic: Qiaozhou's seat was moved to Xinchang commandery, and Qin commandery placed under it.

s0312.literal: Xuyi and Shennong commanderies were returned to South Yanzhou.
s0312.idiomatic: Xuyi and Shennong commanderies were returned to South Yanzhou.

s0313.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jingxu day, a broom star appeared in Great Horn.
s0313.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jingxu day, a broom star appeared in Great Horn.

s0314.literal: On gengyin day Supervisor of Yuzhou Chen Taogen in his circuit obtained a blue ox and presented it; an edict ordered it returned to the people.
s0314.idiomatic: On gengyin day Chen Taogen, supervisor of Yuzhou, obtained a blue ox in his circuit and presented it; an edict ordered it returned to the people.

s0315.literal: On jiawu day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Grand Temple.
s0315.idiomatic: On jiawu day the emperor sacrificed at the Grand Temple in person.

s0316.literal: On yiwei day Chen Taogen again memorialized presenting two hundred pieces each of woven silk and brocade coverlets; [17] an edict ordered them burned outside the Cloud Dragon Gate.
s0316.idiomatic: On yiwei day Chen Taogen again memorialized presenting two hundred pieces each of woven silk and brocade coverlets; [17] an edict ordered them burned outside the Cloud Dragon Gate.

s0317.literal: On renzi day Yingzhou presented six auspicious bells.
s0317.idiomatic: On renzi day Yingzhou presented six auspicious bells.

s0318.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Qin commandery of Qiaozhou was detached and returned to South Yanzhou.
s0318.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Qin commandery of Qiaozhou was returned to South Yanzhou.

s0319.literal: North Beiqiao county was split off to establish North Beiqiao commandery, governing North Beiqiao and West Beiqiao counties belonging to Yangping.
s0319.idiomatic: North Beiqiao county was split off to establish North Beiqiao commandery, governing North Beiqiao and West Beiqiao counties of Yangping.

s0320.literal: South Liang commandery of Hezhou was placed under Qiaozhou.
s0320.idiomatic: South Liang commandery of Hezhou was placed under Qiaozhou.

s0321.literal: In the sixth month, on jingxu day, a day was set for mourning those who died in service on the northern campaign.
s0321.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jingxu day, a day was set to mourn those who died on the northern campaign.

s0322.literal: On renchen day Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing Wang Chang was made Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing.
s0322.idiomatic: On renchen day Wang Chang, right ministerial aide, was made ministerial aide.

s0323.literal: On jiyou day the Cloud Dragon and Spirit Beast gates were rebuilt.
s0323.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Cloud Dragon and Spirit Beast gates were rebuilt.

s0325.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on renyin day, Xiyang commandery's seat was moved to Baocheng.
s0325.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renyin day, Xiyang commandery's seat was moved to Baocheng.

s0326.literal: On guimao day Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0326.idiomatic: On guimao day Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0327.literal: On renchen, intercalary ninth month, Area Commander Wu Mingche inflicted a great defeat on Qi troops at Lüliang.
s0327.idiomatic: On renchen, intercalary ninth month, area commander Wu Mingche inflicted a great defeat on Qi troops at Lüliang.

s0328.literal: That month sweet dew repeatedly fell in the Pleasure Tour Park.
s0328.idiomatic: That month sweet dew repeatedly fell in the Pleasure Tour Park.

s0329.literal: On dingwei day the imperial carriage visited the Pleasure Tour Park, gathered sweet dew, and feasted the hundred officials; an edict ordered a Sweet Dew Pavilion erected on Dragon Boat Hill in the park.
s0329.idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor visited the Pleasure Tour Park, gathered sweet dew, and feasted the ministers; an edict ordered a Sweet Dew Pavilion built on Dragon Boat Hill in the park.

s0330.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu day, Campaign North General and Inspector of South Xuzhou Prince Boshan of Poyang was made Campaign South General and Inspector of Jiangzhou;
s0330.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the tenth month of winter, Boshan, Prince of Poyang, campaign north general and inspector of South Xuzhou, was made campaign south general and inspector of Jiangzhou;

s0331.literal: Secure Van General and Central Army Commander Prince Bogu of Xin'an was made Inspector of South Xuzhou and advanced to Garrison North General;
s0331.idiomatic: Bogu, Prince of Xin'an, secure van general and central army commander, was made inspector of South Xuzhou and promoted to garrison north general;

s0332.literal: Trustworthy Might General and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Shujian of Changsha was made Cloud-Banner General and Central Army Commander.
s0332.idiomatic: Shujian, Prince of Changsha, trustworthy might general and inspector of Jiangzhou, was made cloud-banner general and central army commander.

s0333.literal: [19] On jisi day Prince Shuji was established as King of Xincai and Prince Shuwen as King of Jinxi.
s0333.idiomatic: [19] On jisi day Prince Shuji was made king of Xincai and Prince Shuwen king of Jinxi.

s0334.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengxu day, Campaign West Grand General, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Yingzhou Chunyu Liang was made Grand General of the Central Army.
s0334.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengxu day, Chunyu Liang, campaign west grand general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of Yingzhou, was made grand general of the central army.

s0335.literal: On jingchen day the newly appointed Cloud-Banner General and Inspector of Yingzhou Prince Shujian of Changsha was made Pacify-the-Yue Central Bulwark General and Inspector of Guangzhou; Eastern Central Bulwark General and Inspector of East Yangzhou Prince Shuqing of Jian'an was made Cloud-Banner General and Inspector of Yingzhou; Spread Grace General Prince Shuming of Yidu was made Inspector of East Yangzhou.
s0335.idiomatic: On jingchen day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, newly appointed cloud-banner general and inspector of Yingzhou, was made pacify-the-yue central bulwark general and inspector of Guangzhou; Shuqing, Prince of Jian'an, eastern central bulwark general and inspector of East Yangzhou, was made cloud-banner general and inspector of Yingzhou; Shuming, Prince of Yidu, spread-grace general, was made inspector of East Yangzhou.

s0336.literal: On renxu day Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing Wang Chang was made Left Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing; Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and Senior Rectifier of Yangzhou Lu Chuan was made Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing; and Director of the Directorate of Education Xu Ling was made General of the Garrison Army.
s0336.idiomatic: On renxu day Wang Chang, ministerial aide, was made left ministerial aide; Lu Chuan, grand mentor of the heir apparent and senior rectifier of Yangzhou, was made right ministerial aide; and Xu Ling, director of the directorate of education, was made general of the garrison army.

s0337.literal: On jiazi day Nankang commandery presented an auspicious bell.
s0337.idiomatic: On jiazi day Nankang commandery presented an auspicious bell.

s0338.literal: In the first month of spring of the eighth year, on gengchen day, purple clouds appeared in the southwest.
s0338.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 8, on gengchen day, purple clouds appeared in the southwest.

s0339.literal: In the second month, on renshen day, Chariots-and-Cavalry Grand General, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes Wu Mingche was advanced to Minister of Works.
s0339.idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen day, Wu Mingche, chariots-and-cavalry grand general and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, was promoted to minister of works.

s0340.literal: On dingchou day an edict remitted all summer levies and field taxes of the Jiang-east circuit owed from before Taijian year 5 that still lay among the people.
s0340.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict remitted all summer levies and field taxes of the Jiang-east circuit owed from before Taijian year 5 that still lay among the people.

s0341.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, an edict said: "The main army returns in victory; the hosts shake their banners; merit should be marked and reward feasted.
s0341.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, an edict declared: "The main army returns victorious; the hosts shake their banners; merit should be marked and reward feasted.

s0342.literal: On the seventeenth of this month We may visit the Pleasure Tour Park, set silk-and-bamboo music, and hold a great assembly of civil and military officials."
s0342.idiomatic: On the seventeenth of this month We may visit the Pleasure Tour Park, set music, and hold a great feast for civil and military officials."

s0343.literal: On jiwei day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Grand Temple.
s0343.idiomatic: On jiwei day the emperor sacrificed at the Grand Temple in person.

s0344.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin day, [20] Left Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing Wang Chang died.
s0344.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin day, [20] Wang Chang, left ministerial aide, died.

s0345.literal: In the sixth month, on guichou day, Cloud-Banner General and Inspector of Guangzhou Prince Shujian of Changsha was made Inspector of Hezhou and advanced to Pacify North General.
s0345.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guichou day, Shujian, Prince of Changsha, cloud-banner general and inspector of Guangzhou, was made inspector of Hezhou and promoted to pacify north general.

s0346.literal: On jiayin day Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing Lu Chuan was made Left Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing; newly appointed Administrator of Jinling Wang Ke was made Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing.
s0346.idiomatic: On jiayin day Lu Chuan, right ministerial aide, was made left ministerial aide; Wang Ke, newly appointed administrator of Jinling, was made right ministerial aide.

s0347.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingmao day, Chariots-and-Cavalry Grand General and Minister of Works Wu Mingche was made Inspector of South Yanzhou.
s0347.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingmao day, Wu Mingche, chariots-and-cavalry grand general and minister of works, was made inspector of South Yanzhou.

s0348.literal: In the ninth month, on wuxu day, Prince Shubiao was established as King of Huainan.
s0348.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuxu day, Prince Shubiao was made king of Huainan.

s0349.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on yiyou day, Pacify South General and Inspector of Xiangzhou Prince Shujian of Changsha was made Pacify West General and Inspector of Yingzhou.
s0349.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on yiyou day, Shujian, Prince of Changsha, pacify south general and inspector of Xiangzhou, was made pacify west general and inspector of Yingzhou.

s0350.literal: [21] On dingyou day Jinxi, Gaotang, and Xincai commanderies of Jiangzhou were split off to establish Jinzhou.
s0350.idiomatic: [21] On dingyou day Jinxi, Gaotang, and Xincai commanderies of Jiangzhou were split off to establish Jinzhou.

s0351.literal: On xinchou day Champion General Prince Boren of Luling was made Central Army Commander.
s0351.idiomatic: On xinchou day Boren, Prince of Luling, champion general, was made central army commander.

s0352.literal: On dingmao day the newly appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Xu Ling was made Right Grand Master of the Palace.
s0352.idiomatic: On dingmao day Xu Ling, newly appointed grand mentor of the heir apparent, was made right grand master of the palace.

s0353.literal: In the first month of spring of the ninth year, on xinmao day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the northern suburbs.
s0353.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 9, on xinmao day, the emperor sacrificed at the northern suburbs in person.

s0354.literal: On renyin day Inspector of Xiangzhou and newly appointed Central Guard General Prince Shuling of Shixing was made Inspector of Yangzhou;
s0354.idiomatic: On renyin day Shuling, Prince of Shixing, inspector of Xiangzhou and newly appointed central guard general, was made inspector of Yangzhou;

s0355.literal: Cloud-Banner General Prince Shuqing of Jian'an was made Inspector of Xiangzhou and advanced to Pacify South General.
s0355.idiomatic: Shuqing, Prince of Jian'an, cloud-banner general, was made inspector of Xiangzhou and promoted to pacify south general.

s0356.literal: In the second month, on ren
s0356.idiomatic: In the second month, on ren

s0358.literal: Editorial footnote marker 22. On zi day the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
s0358.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 22. On zi day the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

s0359.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on jingzi day, an edict said: "We rise at dawn to seek clothes and eat only after the sun is down, thinking to extend the myriad people and bring them to good order; yet prefects and governors who face the people have not yet brought honest rule to fullness, and year after year field rents often leave arrears—here the matter is farming and lenience should be broadened.
s0359.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on jingzi day, an edict declared: "We rise at dawn to seek clothes and eat only after the sun is down, thinking to extend the myriad people and bring them to good order; yet prefects and governors who face the people have not yet brought honest rule to fullness, and year after year field rents often leave arrears—here the matter is farming and lenience should be broadened.

s0360.literal: All field levies and taxes carried by households displaced or in rebellion from Taijian onward through year 8; rebel corvée of years 7 and 8 and rebel military service of years 5 through 8; field rice, millet, summer levies of silk, gauze, silk cloth, and wheat owed in years 6 and 7; [23] and owed tribute silk of years 5 through 7—all are wholly remitted."
s0360.idiomatic: All field levies and taxes carried by households displaced or in rebellion from Taijian onward through year 8; rebel corvée of years 7 and 8 and rebel military service of years 5 through 8; field rice, millet, summer levies of silk, gauze, silk cloth, and wheat owed in years 6 and 7; [23] and owed tribute silk of years 5 through 7—all are wholly remitted."

s0361.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Light Chariots General and Governor of Danyang Prince Boyi of Jiangxia was made Inspector of Hezhou.
s0361.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Boyi, Prince of Jiangxia, light chariots general and governor of Danyang, was made inspector of Hezhou.

s0362.literal: On jimao day the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
s0362.idiomatic: On jimao day Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

s0363.literal: On gengchen day great rain fell; the spirit tablet at Wan'an Mausoleum was struck by lightning.
s0363.idiomatic: On gengchen day heavy rain fell; the spirit tablet at Wan'an Mausoleum was struck by lightning.

s0364.literal: On jichou day the finial of Huiri Temple and the double gates of Waguan Temple were struck; one woman at the gate was killed by the strike.
s0364.idiomatic: On jichou day the finial of Huiri Temple and the double gates of Waguan Temple were struck; a woman at the gate was killed by lightning.

s0365.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu day, Minister of Works Wu Mingche defeated Zhou General Liang Shiyan's host of tens of thousands at Lüliang.
s0365.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu day, Wu Mingche, minister of works, defeated the Zhou general Liang Shiyan's host of tens of thousands at Lüliang.

s0366.literal: On wushen day the Eastern Palace was completed; the crown prince moved to the new palace.
s0366.idiomatic: On wushen day the Eastern Palace was completed; the crown prince moved to the new palace.

s0367.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on jisi, the new moon, Central Army Commander Prince Boren of Luling was made Pacify North General and Inspector of South Xuzhou; Assist-the-Left General, [24] Right Grand Master of the Palace, and Concurrent Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Xu Ling was made General of the Garrison Army.
s0367.idiomatic: On jisi, the new moon of the first month of spring in year 10, Boren, Prince of Luling, central army commander, was made pacify north general and inspector of South Xuzhou; Xu Ling, assist-the-left general, [24] right grand master of the palace, and concurrent grand mentor of the heir apparent, was made general of the garrison army.

s0368.literal: In the second month, on jiazi day, the northern campaign armies were defeated at Lüliang; Minister of Works Wu Mingche and commanders and soldiers down to the ranks were all captured by Zhou troops.
s0368.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi day, the northern campaign armies were defeated at Lüliang; Wu Mingche, minister of works, and commanders and soldiers down to the ranks were all captured by Zhou troops.

s0369.literal: In the third month, on xinwei day, the armory was struck by lightning.
s0369.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei day, the armory was struck by lightning.

s0370.literal: On jingzi day separate orders were sent to the hosts to prepare against Zhou: Grand General of the Central Army, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes Chunyu Liang was made Supreme Commander, commanding all land and water forces;
s0370.idiomatic: On jingzi day separate orders were sent to the hosts to prepare against Zhou: Chunyu Liang, grand general of the central army and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, was made supreme commander over all land and water forces;

s0371.literal: Martial-display General Sun Yang was made area commander of Jing and Ying land and water forces and advanced to Garrison West General;
s0371.idiomatic: Sun Yang, martial-display general, was made area commander of Jing and Ying land and water forces and promoted to garrison west general;

s0372.literal: Left Guard General Fan Yi was made Supreme Commander, commanding all armies along the Huai from Zhupu and Qingkou up to Jingshan; he was advanced to Pacify North General;
s0372.idiomatic: Fan Yi, left guard general, was made supreme commander of all armies along the Huai from Zhupu and Qingkou up to Jingshan and promoted to pacify north general;

s0373.literal: Martial-resolve General Ren Zhong was made commander of the armies of Shouyang, Xincai, Huozhou, and the like; he was advanced to Secure Distance General.
s0373.idiomatic: Ren Zhong, martial-resolve general, was made commander of the armies of Shouyang, Xincai, Huozhou, and the like and promoted to secure distance general.

s0374.literal: On yiyou day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0374.idiomatic: On yiyou day the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

s0375.literal: On dingyou day Grand General of the Central Army, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes, and Protector General Chunyu Liang was made Inspector of South Yanzhou and advanced to Chariots-and-Cavalry Grand General.
s0375.idiomatic: On dingyou day Chunyu Liang, grand general of the central army, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and protector general, was made inspector of South Yanzhou and promoted to chariots-and-cavalry grand general.

s0376.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu day, an edict said: "Words of splendid reward are clear in the instructions; the beauty of giving padded garments is set forth in comforting tours.
s0376.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu day, an edict declared: "Words of splendid reward are clear in the instructions; the beauty of giving padded garments is set forth in comforting tours.

s0377.literal: In recent years on limited campaigns We cleared Huai and Si; striking the van and winning fruit, civil and military alike gave their strength; wind in the hair and rain on the body, cold and heat in quick succession—thinking of their merit, We do not forget it at the final meal.
s0377.idiomatic: In recent years on limited campaigns We cleared Huai and Si; striking the van and winning fruit, civil and military alike gave their strength; wind in the hair and rain on the body, cold and heat in quick succession—thinking of their merit, We do not forget it at the final meal.

s0378.literal: Rewards of glory should be distributed to repay this toil.
s0378.idiomatic: Rewards of glory should be distributed to repay this toil.

s0379.literal: Those who were in the army may all be granted two ranks of nobility, with added bounty and relief; the personnel office is to measure and dispose at once."
s0379.idiomatic: Those who were in the army may all receive two ranks of nobility, with added bounty and relief; the personnel office is to measure and dispose at once."

s0380.literal: Another edict said: "Only Yao wore hemp and deerskin yet took Heaven as great; Yu wore worn clothes and coarse food yet the Master said there was no fault in him—thus in thrifty virtue there is reverence, and in excessive loss there is little error.
s0380.idiomatic: A further edict declared: "Only Yao wore hemp and deerskin yet took Heaven as great; Yu wore worn clothes and coarse food yet the Master said there was no fault in him—thus in thrifty virtue there is reverence, and in excessive loss there is little error.

s0381.literal: We face the cosmos; the year tallies have turned ten times; from dawn We do not rest, at the second watch We forget sleep; standing on tiptoe We think of order as if crossing a great stream; mindful of this, mindful of this, We are as fearful as driving a rotten cart.
s0381.idiomatic: We face the cosmos; the year tallies have turned ten times; from dawn We do not rest, at the second watch We forget sleep; standing on tiptoe We think of order as if crossing a great stream; mindful of this, mindful of this, We are as fearful as driving a rotten cart.

s0382.literal: It is not from greed for the wealth of the four seas, nor from thinking on the honor of the yellow canopy; We guide benevolence and longevity to settle the myriad lives and would rather labor in service than be served by all.
s0382.idiomatic: It is not from greed for the wealth of the four seas, nor from thinking on the honor of the yellow canopy; We guide benevolence and longevity to settle the myriad lives and would rather labor in service than be served by all.

s0383.literal: But inheriting the Liang season, disorder left its wounds; palace halls were millet, famous yet without place; though the splendor of the halls was not yet seen, We have somewhat undertaken construction; removing excess, removing extremity, it is still labor and expense.
s0383.idiomatic: But inheriting the Liang season, disorder left its wounds; palace halls were millet, famous yet without place; though the splendor of the halls was not yet seen, We have somewhat undertaken construction; removing excess, removing extremity, it is still labor and expense.

s0384.literal: Moreover war chariots have repeatedly gone forth; a thousand in gold is lost daily; the treasury is not full and the people are worn by levies.
s0384.idiomatic: Moreover war chariots have repeatedly gone forth; a thousand in gold is lost daily; the treasury is not full and the people are worn by levies.

s0385.literal: If the people are not sufficient, with whom does the ruler share sufficiency?
s0385.idiomatic: If the people are not sufficient, with whom does the ruler share sufficiency?

s0386.literal: Speaking in stillness and thinking, evening care fills Our embrace; in handing down instruction and setting law, We are much ashamed.
s0386.idiomatic: Speaking in stillness and thinking, evening care fills Our embrace; in handing down instruction and setting law, We are much ashamed.

s0387.literal: To carve and make plain is what one may admire; since the phoenix-head garments have been burned, the silk-fishing garments are now worn; the regulations for reduction and withdrawal begin with Our own person; when the grass lies down the wind moves, We hope thereby to change custom.
s0387.idiomatic: To carve and make plain is what one may admire; since the phoenix-head garments have been burned, the silk-fishing garments are now worn; the regulations for reduction and withdrawal begin with Our own person; when the grass lies down the wind moves, We hope thereby to change custom.

s0388.literal: Apart from ritual instruments, ceremonial dress, and military gear built by the imperial workshops and government halls, all the rest is to cease entirely;
s0388.idiomatic: Apart from ritual instruments, ceremonial dress, and military gear built by the imperial workshops and government halls, all the rest is to cease entirely;

s0389.literal: Regular supplies of the inner palace, stipends of princes and princesses, and all such allowances are each to be reduced in measure.
s0389.idiomatic: Regular supplies of the inner palace, stipends of princes and princesses, and all such allowances are each to be reduced in measure.

s0390.literal: On dingsi day the newly appointed Guard-the-Right General Prince Bogu of Xin'an was made Protector General.
s0390.idiomatic: On dingsi day Bogu, Prince of Xin'an, newly appointed guard-the-right general, was made protector general.

s0391.literal: On wuwu day Fan Yi sent troops across the Huai to the north to face Qingkou and build a city.
s0391.idiomatic: On wuwu day Fan Yi sent troops across the Huai to the north to face Qingkou and build a city.

s0392.literal: On gengshen day great hail fell.
s0392.idiomatic: On gengshen day great hail fell.

s0393.literal: On renxu day Qingkou city could not be held.
s0393.idiomatic: On renxu day Qingkou city could not be held.

s0394.literal: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, the Metal Star was seen in daylight.
s0394.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, Venus appeared by day.

s0395.literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, great rain fell; the finial of the Great Imperial Temple, the bowl of Zhuangyan Temple, the east tower of the Chongyang Pavilion, the locust tree inside the Thousand Autumns Gate, and the gate of the Court for Guests of the Realm were struck.
s0395.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, heavy rain fell; the finial of the Great Imperial Temple, the bowl of Zhuangyan Temple, the east tower of the Chongyang Pavilion, the locust tree inside the Thousand Autumns Gate, and the gate of the Court for Guests of the Realm were struck by lightning.

s0396.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu day, the state of Silla sent envoys presenting local products.
s0396.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu day, Silla sent envoys with tribute.

s0397.literal: On yisi day Regular Attendant and Concurrent Minister of Personnel Yuan Xian was made Minister of Personnel.
s0397.idiomatic: On yisi day Yuan Xian, regular attendant and concurrent minister of personnel, was made minister of personnel.

s0398.literal: On yichou, the new moon of the eighth month, Qin commandery was changed to Yizhou.
